system.description: Send a huge wave of water with a width of five yards + Arcane Might; it continues forward up to thirty yards. All creatures caught in the wave must make a basic Strength + Endurance roll; on a failure the target is swept up in the wave, moved towards its final destination, and knocked prone. Deals 6 + Arcane Might blunt damage to the first rank of people it strikes, and 3 + Arcane Might to all creatures struck afterwards.
